dedupeResult: Repository code search returned no existing canonical match for FBi Radio, WNAA 90.1 FM HD or Kennesaw State Owl Radio by official platform name, domain, submission path or published contact before creation. FBi specialist-show mailboxes and paid promotion, WNAA general/contact pages, and Owl Radio staff, advertising and physical-mail details were retained as evidence or boundaries rather than duplicated as separate opportunities.
emailVerificationLevel: music@fbiradio.com and wnaafm@ncat.edu were verified by first-party publication, syntax and explicit submission purpose. The WNAA address is parent-university-domain aligned; the FBi address uses the station's legacy business domain. Owl Radio's first-party follow-up Gmail and current university programme contact were recorded as general contacts only and not substituted for the official form. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
formVerificationLevel: Owl Radio exposes an official university-hosted multi-step first page with artist, email, bio, MP3/WAV upload and music-link fields. Live later steps could not be passively retrieved, so login, session, CAPTCHA, privacy, retention and final consent boundaries remain unknown. FBi and WNAA use official public email routes. No visible mandatory payment was observed; FBi's separate paid promotion was excluded.
safety: All three opportunities were queued as needs_manual_review. No email was sent, no form field was filled, no file, image or press kit was uploaded or attached, no physical item was mailed, no consent was accepted, no login was attempted, no CAPTCHA or anti-spam control was bypassed and no payment or submission action was completed.
